body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Digifi(www.digifi.kr) expects to unveil its wireless earphone 'Opera S5' designed for iPod at the upcoming CES 2009 held in Las Vegas.

Compatible with all iPod products such as iPod Nano, iPod Classic, iPod Touch and iPhone, the Opera S5 consists of a digital audio signal transmission and a dongle. A remote control on the ear sets allows you to control the volume and play & pause.
